ns2:section.sectionText: 3 hours. This course satisfies the General Education Criteria for a Life Sciences course. This is an online course taught in the Moodle course management system with no classroom sessions. Although there are no scheduled meeting times, there are weekly assignment and project due dates.The final exam will be face-to-face May 8-15, and will be arranged by the instructor with the Office of the Registrar to avoid conflicts. Register for both the Online Lecture and Online Discussion.
